description: Everolimus, in combination with exemestane, is recommended within its marketing authorisation, as an option for treating advanced HER2-negative, hormone-receptor-positive breast cancer in postmenopausal women without symptomatic visceral disease that has recurred or progressed after a non-steroidal aromatase inhibitor. Everolimus is recommended only if the company provides it with the discount agreed in the patient access scheme.
